sources.version: Living docs; explicit Collect v2025.2.0 / Central v2025.1.4 feature gate

locators.section: Finalizing drafts; Sending finalized forms; Editing finalized or sent forms

sources.subject_operation: Collect device-local Draft/Ready to send/Sent; opt-in edits of retained finalized/sent submissions
sources.conditions: Off by default; settings.client_editable=true. Edits use the original form definition, are tracked in Central, and manually queued edits must be sent in order. A Central-side edit makes that submission no longer editable from Collect. Entities are not updated by these edits.
sources.applies_to: Final lines 11,25,38,47–56,62,101 and inherited S01/C01/R01. Conditional product fit and correction option are supported.
sources.limits: No deployed versions observed. Final prose compresses the Central-edit lockout, retained explicitly in inherited source-map S01. Queue visibility beyond the device is an inference/proposal, not built-in evidence.

sources.version: Living protocol documentation; no product build pinned

locators.section: Form Identity; Version; Completed Form Metadata; ID constraints

sources.subject_operation: XForm identity/version and submission metadata
sources.conditions: Form version is a string. instanceID is required and universally unique; timeStart/timeEnd are optional ISO 8601 form-entry timestamps. deprecatedID identifies the preceding submission; consolidation is server behavior. IDs use scheme:value.
sources.applies_to: Final lines 71–81, S02/C02; separates site/visit/event, form definition, reported observation time, and unverified client clock.
sources.limits: Metadata is not proof of accurate device time, immutable audit history, or a correction display policy. Attachment IDs/digests are proposed application fields.

sources.title: Central form versions, access, and export schema
sources.version: Living docs; drafting/version updates since Central 0.8
sources.subject_operation: Publishing a new form version and exporting old submissions
sources.conditions: Explicit App User access is required. Prior submissions remain unchanged after republishing; default export uses current fields, with an option for previously removed fields. Reused fields retain their datatype, except conversion to text.
sources.applies_to: Final 11,62,74 and S03/C03; version-preserving record model and export warning.
sources.limits: Actual old-form intake, roles, and deployed schema compatibility remain untested; no universal arbitrary schema migration is promised.

locators.section: Review States; Editing; Offline Web Forms

sources.subject_operation: CSV ZIP download and submission review/version workflow
sources.conditions: ZIP includes root/repeat join CSVs and files/submission-instanceId directories. Filters affect exports. Edits create versions and Edited state. ODK Web Forms need connectivity to submit; Enketo offline queue auto-send needs the form open.
sources.applies_to: Final 11,40–41,62; C-04 locator correction; inherited S04/C04/R02.
sources.limits: Ordinary CSV export is not an audit export of every correction; the final correctly proposes checking history/export and does not claim this test ran.

sources.title: Central REST submission management
sources.version: Living API; attachment upload since 0.4, versions since 1.2, device metadata since 1.4
sources.subject_operation: REST POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/forms/{xmlFormId}/submissions; expected attachment uploads; version retrieval
sources.conditions: POST requires XML Content-Type and creates from submission XML; attachments are separate expected slots. Existing instanceId returns 409. createdAt is ISO string server receive time, distinct from currentVersion.createdAt. Initial instanceId stays the logical submission ID; each version has its own ID.
sources.limits: Does not establish a native CSV importer. Different from Collect's OpenRosa retry endpoint (E19); the final's reconciliation advice is safe but its short 409 wording should be read with that endpoint scope.

sources.subject_operation: Lost server response followed by editing failed local XML and retrying the same instance ID

sources.applies_to: Final 28,99–101; S06/C06. Historical bounded example, not current deployment diagnosis.
sources.limits: Issue discussion is not a live reproduction or universal network guarantee.

sources.subject_operation: Publish-time layer sync and field-app Sent editing
sources.conditions: Enable sync is off when publishing new feature layers; offline map areas need it. Only applicable publish options are shown for existing layers. Sent editing is off by default; Sent+Inbox can retain stale records changed elsewhere.

sources.title: Survey123 correction paths and limits
sources.version: Global-ID URL editing from 3.9; older Enterprise attachment edit limit before 10.8.1
sources.subject_operation: Editing an individual response versus directly editing table cells
sources.conditions: Individual response: submitter AND viewer plus add/update privileges. URL edit: submitter OR owner with add/update. Attachments editable in individual/web form paths; not in table cells. Nested repeats unsupported; older Enterprise attachment surveys unsupported. Table edits bypass constraints/calculations and cannot be undone.
sources.applies_to: Final 63 and S11/C11 conditional correction recommendation.
sources.limits: These are edit-path permissions, not proof of append-only history. Brief-authorized separate correction events remain a proposed route.

sources.conditions: CSV, Excel, KML, shapefile, file geodatabase; choices use names rather than labels. FGDB removes attachment KEYWORD. ArcGIS Server feature-layer surveys cannot be downloaded in this website route; unmatched attachment keywords prevent website editing.
sources.applies_to: Final 13,26,40,63; C-03 corrected omission; S12/C12/R04.
sources.limits: Does not exclude all Enterprise exports. Final source-map retains keyword specifics; final prose gives a broader attachment warning.

sources.title: CouchDB replication checkpoints
sources.version: Apache CouchDB 3.5.1 documentation
sources.subject_operation: One-way document replication and restart recovery
sources.conditions: Changes-feed batches compare existing revisions; checkpoints allow restarted tasks to resume. Persistent versus transient task lifecycle differs; two directions require two tasks.
sources.applies_to: Final 17,65; S13/C15. Architectural analogy only.
sources.limits: No custom sync implementation or exactly-once guarantee is established.

sources.operation: Independent unauthenticated HTTP GET; no product operation or downloaded-code execution
sources.title: CouchDB conflict leaves and winner visibility
sources.version: Apache CouchDB 3.5.1 documentation
sources.subject_operation: Concurrent leaf revisions, ordinary reads, and explicit application conflict resolution
sources.conditions: Default reads/views expose only a deterministic winner; conflicts can be retrieved. Non-leaf bodies are discarded by compaction; revision pruning exists. Revision trees are not an unlimited immutable audit log.
sources.applies_to: Final 17,65; S14/C16. Keeps owner policy separate from database winner.
sources.limits: Candidate uses branches as an analogy, not an actual retention design. No material audit-history dependency on CouchDB is proposed.

sources.version: Support page last updated 2026-07-17; app build not pinned

sources.conditions: Initial deployed/shared form and configured project needed. Updates need connectivity. Drafts editable; finalize/send conditions follow settings. Originals remain locally by default; optional Delete after send changes that.
sources.limits: Original personal-phone retention policy is not selected or exercised. No native legacy CSV import conclusion follows.

sources.version: Support page last updated 2026-05-06; app build not pinned
sources.subject_operation: Server-side edits to submitted KoboCollect data
sources.conditions: No post-submit edit/delete in KoboCollect. Saved edits update _uuid; rootUuid stays stable. Web edits use latest form and can remove old fields. Raw edits cannot be undone; external log/comments recommended. Project history logs can track edit/deletion events.
sources.applies_to: Final 15,64,93; S16/C14/R08. Screening caveat is evidence-based.
sources.limits: External-log wording is stronger than the source's recommendation; built-in activity history is an additional opportunity, not demonstrated before/after retention. Conditional Kobo screening is not an evidence-based product ban.

locators.section: Upsert; capability; supportsAppend; formats; sync; images

sources.subject_operation: Conditional CSV loading into a supported feature-service layer/table, separate from Survey123-native import
sources.conditions: Target must advertise supportsAppend and CSV in supportedAppendFormats. Owners/admins bypass needing Append capability; other callers need it. Upsert updates matching records and is blocked with sync/changeTracking. Non-upsert allocates new ObjectID/GlobalID. imageCollection creates geometry from EXIF; absent-location images skipped by default.
sources.applies_to: Final 29,31,39,63,92,95; R06. Proposed safe import and negative-constraint exclusion are supported.
sources.limits: No safe photo association, idempotency, schema, timestamps, or service configuration is established. Final proposes validating them and does not adopt upsert as the dedupe mechanism.

sources.title: Central OpenRosa submission endpoint governing Collect retries
sources.version: Living Central OpenRosa API; submission endpoint since 0.1
sources.subject_operation: Multipart OpenRosa POST, including repeated attachment requests and explicit updates
sources.conditions: Same-ID XML must stay identical across multipart/retry requests; changed XML or deleted submission returns 409. Explicit updates use deprecatedID, replace XML entirely, reject a stale predecessor, and carry media by filename reference.
sources.applies_to: Independently checks final 25,49–52,91,99–101 and E05 scope. Reinforces immutable retry and distinct corrections.
sources.limits: REST-create 409 is not the precise identical-payload Collect retry rule. No guaranteed success under every network failure is asserted.
